definitions.gloss: chikuzenni; braised chicken and root vegetables
definitions.explanation: a traditional Japanese dish of chicken and root vegetables sautéed then simmered in dashi, soy sauce, and mirin; named after the Chikuzen region of northern Kyushu

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Named after {筑前|ちくぜん}, the old name for the northern part of present-day Fukuoka Prefecture, where the dish is called がめ{煮|に}. Chicken, taro, carrot, lotus root, burdock, shiitake, and konnyaku are first stir-fried in oil and then simmered in dashi, soy sauce, and mirin; the frying step sets it apart from an ordinary ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧. It is a standard of New Year's おせち and of home cooking.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧: simmered dish — the general category; {筑前煮|ちくぜんに} is one well-known kind.
